title: Purple Crescent Warrior
description: A young female warrior with white and purple hair styled in buns stands in a dynamic pose against a solid gray background. She holds a large purple crescent moon blade, wears traditional East Asian inspired white and purple robes with bone decorations, and has a glowing purple halo of energy above her head.
prompt: A fierce young East Asian female warrior with long white hair dyed purple at the tips, styled in two buns with decorative elements, stands in a combat stance. She wields a large vibrant purple crescent moon blade, wears flowing white and purple traditional robes with blue patterns and bone tassels, a purple sash, and has a glowing purple jagged energy halo floating above her head. Solid gray background, dynamic pose, digital illustration style
